upstream.target: default scalar x86_64 Linux LP64 build (RAR5 & 7-Zip readers)

summary.en: Top-down Lean 4 safety invariants and strict ISO C17 runtime bootstrap for libarchive's RAR5 and 7-Zip format decoders; statement-by-statement C translation safety proofs are not done.
summary.zh: 针对 libarchive 中 RAR5 与 7-Zip 归档格式解码器的 Lean 4 顶层安全不变量模型与严格 ISO C17 运行时基座；C 逐语句翻译的安全性证明尚未完成。
